---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability, adapter, or improvement for JoBot
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem statement**

What are you trying to accomplish, and what stops you today? Describe the
workflow or outcome you want, not only the mechanism you imagine. If this
relates to a limitation of an existing adapter (for example, discovery works
but apply is not supported for a site), say what currently happens.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like JoBot to do. Include any API endpoints, page structures,
or commands you already know are relevant.

**Alternatives you have considered**

Other ways to solve the problem, including manual workarounds, existing CLI
flags or configuration you tried, or third-party tools. Why are the
alternatives insufficient?

**Adapter / site concerned**

Which site adapter or component this concerns (for example: naukri, linkedin,
workday, greenhouse, lever, scrapers, documents/PDF, tracker, scheduler,
sidecar, GUI). Write "core" for cross-cutting requests.

Note: JoBot does not build features whose purpose is to defeat anti-bot
controls or platform Terms of Service (see SECURITY.md, "Known accepted
residuals"). Requests in that category will be declined.
